objectives: Students will be able to understand the essential theories and principles governing practice in education law and policy.
Students will be able to understand the academic and professional options and opportunities provided by the certificate program.
Students will be able to understand essential law and policy research and writing skills necessary to begin work on an individual law- and/or policy-related research or practice problem.
Students will be able to understand the essential law and policy knowledge and skills they need for a successful educational experience in the program.
Students will also understand how to begin and continue their research throughout the program of study in preparation for completion and presentation of their work in the capstone seminar.
topics: 1) Overview of Education Law and Policy Principles and Practice 2) Essential Principles of Law, Policy, and Governance 3
